releases.name: Bloodborne for Windows 1.9.4: online connection fix and better settings for laptops
releases.notes:
A small update to 1.9.3 with an online fix and better settings for laptops. With work from Awaken (online) and Nick (launcher).

Updating: press Update in the launcher, or unpack the zip over your install. Your saves, settings and mods are kept.

On 1.9.3? Its launcher can't update itself (fixed in 1.9.4): download Bloodborne-Windows.zip below and unpack it over your install (your saves, settings and mods are kept). After that, new versions show up in the launcher again.

Online

  • "Failed to acquire Bloodborne server information" fixed for players whose antivirus scans HTTPS connections (Avast, AVG, Kaspersky and others), or whose Windows had not fetched a server's root certificate yet. If Windows trusts the server, the game does too; bad certificates are still refused. (Awaken)

Launcher

  • New versions are offered again: 1.9.3's launcher never showed "Version X is available", and "Check for updates" didn't work either.
  • Laptops get the right settings: the hardware check now knows laptop processors (H, HK, U and similar), which are slower than the desktop chips of the same name. When the processor sets the frame rate, the launcher says so and doesn't lower the picture for nothing. (Nick)
  • No more 30 FPS cap on fast PCs: a processor above the minimum with a strong graphics card could get a 30 FPS cap from the automatic settings. (Nick)
  • Game tests are off for now: the "Measure on this PC" tests come back later with a fixed benchmark character. System & tests is now Your PC: its rating and the system requirements. (Nick)
  • Benchmark for bug reports (Advanced): a fixed route in Cathedral Ward on its own save, with your settings, and one zip to send. It now really walks and turns the camera; in 1.9.3 it measured the hunter standing still.

releases.name: Bloodborne for Windows 1.9.3: new launcher, stretched polygons and VRAM fixed
releases.notes:
With work from ethan, Rattensuppe (FSR 4.1.1 and ML frame generation) and Nick (the new launcher). Low-VRAM profile by fixdag and bashiku.

Updating: press Update in the launcher, or unpack the zip over your install. Your saves, settings and mods are kept. The new launcher backs up your saves automatically before every start.

Performance and VRAM

  • GPU layer back to 1.8.2's. The 1.9 graphics update is reverted, which fixes:

    • stretched polygons and "exploding" models;
    • texture stalls on 6–8 GB cards;
    • black screens entering the Hunter's Dream.

    The frame generation memory leak fix and the out-of-VRAM retry are kept.

  • Less VRAM used:

    • the 512 MB reserve only applies on NVIDIA;
    • idle staging memory is freed (about 240 MB);
    • copy buffers are sized to the image;
    • object motion is off below 6 GB.

  • Low-VRAM profile for 4 GB cards (Advanced → Low-VRAM profile: Auto / On / Off). It turns on by itself on cards with 4.5 GB or less: a bigger texture budget, a smaller scene at 1080p with an upscaler, and fewer helper threads on 4-core CPUs.

  • Integrated GPUs: textures go in shared memory.

  • Audio crackling on 6-core CPUs fixed (higher audio thread priority).

  • Direct mouse camera: no more FPS drops while moving the mouse on some PCs.

  • Shader cache: a cache made by another version of the port is no longer loaded by mistake, which could crash the game. Your first start after updating rebuilds the cache, so expect a little stutter at first.

New graphics options (Rattensuppe)

  • FSR 4.1.1 (experimental), two ways:
    • Vulkan (fsr4vk, included);
    • AMD DX12 (AMD cards).
  • AMD ML frame generation 4.0.1 (experimental): RX 9000, Windows 11, 2× SDR. Only offered on supported PCs.
  • Motion-vector cache (experimental): may improve FSR performance, uses some extra VRAM.

Gameplay

  • Rebirth at the Doll: for 5 Insight, go back to your origin's stats and level, then buy your old levels back without Blood Echoes. Optional, on by default.
  • Language is back in the title screen's System menu.
  • Modified eboot.bin (e.g. a 60 FPS patch already applied): the patches that still fit are applied, so ultrawide keeps working.
  • Live resolution Auto keeps working above 1080p with depth of field on.
  • The game still starts if the debug menu's fonts are missing.

Controls

  • Controller rebinding: click a slot, press a button.
  • Button prompts follow your rebinding on PlayStation, Xbox and Switch layouts, including PlayStation symbols the game has no picture of.
  • Lock-on target switching with the mouse, Dark Souls III style.

New launcher (Nick)

  • New look, with a simple view and an expert view.
  • First-start setup guide.
  • "Your goal" picks graphics settings for your PC: Smooth, Balanced or Quiet. The resolution can still be changed in the simple view.
  • Saves page:
    • your characters with level, weapons, beaten bosses and play time;
    • automatic backups before every start;
    • restore a single character;
    • import from shadPS4, Awaken's port and bbhost.
  • "You play with: Controller | Keyboard and mouse" on the Play page, the Controls page and in the setup guide. Keyboard and mouse turns the mouse camera on and sets up the Dark Souls III layout (asking first if you changed keys yourself).
  • Controls page shows the settings for what you play with, including a controller test with a picture of your controller.
  • Gameplay page: the game's text and voice language, intro skip, mute, and the gameplay tweaks (Japanese button layout, Quit to Desktop, Rebirth, camera options), all in the simple view.
  • Launcher customization page: the launcher's language and look, what it does while you play, and shortcuts.
  • New icon: the emblem from the launcher.
  • Help page: checks your install and saves a report for support.
  • Game tests: measure performance, compare settings with screenshots, stability runs. The Cathedral Ward benchmark is a scenario there (Advanced → Benchmark for bug reports), with texture cache and VRAM details for bug reports.
  • Search (Ctrl+F) for any setting.
  • Any output resolution, a choice of game monitor, and DLC status.
  • When the game starts: keep the launcher open, minimize it or close it. Optionally open it again when the game closes, and minimize to the system tray.
  • Settings changed in the in-game menu are kept: the launcher no longer writes its older values over them.
  • Mouse look can be turned off again after using the Dark Souls III layout, and mouse settings changed after saving key bindings are no longer lost.
  • Respec a character (Cheats page).
  • Every text in all 12 languages.

Known issues

  • "SignalFence: Unreachable code" crash at startup still happens occasionally.
  • ML frame generation and FSR 4.1.1 DX12 have only been tested on AMD RX 9000 cards.
  • The field of view setting is now only in the in-game menu (Insert or L3+R3).

releases.name: Bloodborne for Windows 1.9.2: frame generation leak, 4 GB crash and stretched polygons fixed
releases.notes:
Fixes for crashes, video memory and stretched polygons, and a way to go back to an earlier version.

Fixes

  • Frame generation memory leak: with FSR 3.1 frame generation on, video memory grew every frame until the game slowed down and crashed ("device lost"). It now stays steady.
  • 4 GB graphics cards: entering big areas or returning to the Hunter's Dream could crash with "ErrorOutOfDeviceMemory". The game now frees textures it is not using and carries on; you may see a short stutter instead of a crash.
  • Stretched polygons / "vertex explosion": the remaining cases on NVIDIA and Intel GPUs are fixed. The shader cache rebuilds once after updating, so the first minutes may stutter a little.

New

  • Advanced > Other versions…: install any version from 1.8.2 to the newest. Saves, settings and mods are kept. To stay on an older version, switch off "Check for updates when the launcher opens".

Known issues

  • On Intel graphics, stretched polygons can still appear when an upscaler is on.
  • Cards with 4 GB of video memory remain tight in long sessions; FSR 3.1 Performance and a 60 FPS cap help.

releases.name: Bloodborne for Windows 1.9.1: stretched polygons and FPS drop fixed
releases.notes:
Hotfix for two problems that started in 1.9.

Fixes

  • Stretched polygons / "vertex explosion": characters and scenery no longer stretch into huge flat polygons (seen mostly on GTX 16, RTX 20 and Intel GPUs).
  • FPS drop after dying or loading an area: the frame rate no longer falls to 10–25 until a restart, and the lower FPS on 4–8 GB cards since 1.9 is back to 1.8.2 levels. The fix for the 4 GB "ErrorOutOfDeviceMemory" crash is kept, in a way that no longer costs speed.

Frame generation and everything else from 1.9 is unchanged.

releases.name: Bloodborne for Windows 1.9: Frame generation and memory fixes
releases.notes:
New: Frame generation

  • Smoother motion: the game shows extra frames between its own, so 60 FPS on screen becomes 120, or up to 4x.
  • FSR 3.1 on any graphics card (2x), DLSS Frame Generation on GeForce RTX 40 (2x) and RTX 50 (up to 4x).
  • In the launcher and the in-game menu (Insert / L3+R3), with the multiplier.
  • The HUD stays sharp in the generated frames.
  • Works with the FPS unlocked: the multiplier runs as you choose it. "Fit to display refresh" limits it to what your monitor shows.
  • With V-Sync (AMD cards on Windows) the game is capped so all frames fit, e.g. 72 FPS for 2x on a 144 Hz monitor.
  • The FPS counter shows the game's own frame rate beside the total, e.g. "240 FPS (game 60, frame gen 4x)".
  • Adds a little input delay. Menus and movies are not generated.

Fixes

  • 4 GB graphics cards: no more "ErrorOutOfDeviceMemory" crash after visiting several areas (RTX 2050 and similar).
  • Video memory over long sessions: no longer keeps growing from area to area on 6–8 GB cards.
  • Ultrawide and high resolutions: the game starts again on PCs with less RAM or a small page file (5120x1440 stopped at start).
  • Mods: more mod folder layouts load (readme and preview files beside them, extra wrapper folders, screenshot folders). A folder that still can't load is listed in the launcher with the reason.
  • Graphics: many rendering fixes and better performance.
  • Changing the window or output size with full video memory no longer crashes.

releases.name: Bloodborne for Windows 1.8.2: start-up, VRAM and keyboard fixes
releases.notes:
Fixes for problems reported on Discord. Thanks to @emurphy04, @cassioKenji and @parsifal295 for the pull requests these fixes are based on, and to Awaken.

Fixed

  • Game won't start: [WinError 5] Access is denied (often with Quit to Desktop on). Game files copied from a read-only source couldn't be replaced. They can now, and the game files themselves stay untouched
  • Game won't start: Mods: [WinError 1] Incorrect function when the port is on a USB or external drive (exFAT/FAT32). The game now builds what it needs on your system drive instead, and if that still fails it starts without Quit to Desktop rather than not at all
  • Crashes on 4-8 GB graphics cards (ErrorOutOfDeviceMemory) after moving through a few areas. When video memory is full, the game now uses system memory instead of crashing. Textures also aren't thrown away and reloaded every few frames anymore, which was slowing the game down over time on these cards
  • Crash with Out of order flip IRQ after a few minutes
  • Keyboard: running dropped to walking when changing direction (W then D, A to D and so on). The sprint is kept now

Still being worked on

  • The gesture menu and rating messages from the keyboard or an Xbox controller

If something goes wrong

Send the whole user\last_run.log file and say what happened, on our Discord.

releases.name: Bloodborne for Windows 1.8.1: The Hunter's Dream with bbhost players
releases.notes:
Play with bbhost players on The Hunter's Dream again, through bbhost's own network code. Thanks to Awaken for the backend, droogie for bbhost, and Metr1k and The Hunter's Dream team.

How to play on The Hunter's Dream

  1. In the launcher, open Online co-op, tick Play online and choose The Hunter's Dream under Co-op pool
  2. Press Sign in with Discord and enter the code the launcher shows on the page that opens
  3. Press PLAY

No bridge or extra program is needed: the game talks to The Hunter's Dream the same way bbhost does.

If something goes wrong

Send the whole user\last_run.log file and say what happened. Please ask on our Discord, not The Hunter's Dream's.

releases.name: Bloodborne for Windows 1.8: new online code
releases.notes:
New online code, done the way The Hunter's Dream team asked. Big thanks to Awaken (BloodBorneButPc), whose online code bbport now uses, to Metr1k and The Hunter's Dream team for their guidance, and to droogie for bbhost.

Online

  • bbport now uses shadPS4 0.20's network, NP and shadNet code, as put together by Awaken. The old network code is gone
  • The game's own server functions (messages, bloodstains, summon signs) and play logs go over plain HTTP to the game server, never through a shadNet WebAPI
  • bbbridge is removed completely
  • The game now tells servers it is "bbport" and which version, so server teams can always tell builds apart
  • shadNet and SuperMedo Server work as before

Coming next

  • Playing with bbhost players on The Hunter's Dream through bbhost's own network code. It's built in but stays off until The Hunter's Dream team has tested it with us

If something goes wrong

Send the whole user\last_run.log file, along with your CPU and RAM, and when it happened. Please ask on our Discord, not The Hunter's Dream's.

releases.name: Bloodborne for Windows 1.7.8: online fixes for The Hunter's Dream, small fixes
releases.notes:
Online fixes asked for by The Hunter's Dream team, plus small fixes. Thanks to Metr1k for pointing out the problem, and to @parsifal295, bmy and @dGstone18 for the fixes their pull requests suggested.

Online

  • The game's own server functions (messages, bloodstains, summon signs) now go over plain HTTP to the game server only, the way bbhost and Awaken's port do it. They no longer go through a shadNet WebAPI
  • Play logs go to the game server's API port instead of FromSoftware's old storage
  • A leftover bbbridge-live-map.xml in the patches folder (from bbbridge's own app) is ignored

Fixed

  • A broken texture description from the game no longer stops the game
  • No flicker on the animated title menu above 1080p
  • The item picture on the loading screen shows at resolutions other than 1080p
  • If the NVIDIA driver can't start DLSS properly, the game starts without DLSS instead of failing to open

If it crashes

Send the whole user\last_run.log file, along with your CPU and RAM, and when it happened.

releases.name: Bloodborne for Windows 1.7.7: crash fix, GPU info in logs
releases.notes:
Two small fixes. Thanks to @parsifal295 for both ideas.

Fixed

  • A broken graphics command from the game (often right after a save loads, with Unimplemented PM4 type 0 in the log) no longer stops the game. The port skips it and keeps going

Changed

  • Every user\last_run.log now starts with your graphics card, its video memory and the driver version, so crash reports have them without asking

If it crashes

Send the whole user\last_run.log file, along with your CPU and RAM, and when it happened.

releases.name: Bloodborne for Windows 1.7.6: online changes
releases.notes:
Online changes.

Changed

  • The Hunter's Dream co-op pool is turned off until it works properly with their server. If you had it selected, the launcher switches you back to shadNet. Please don't contact The Hunter's Dream for help with bbport, ask on our Discord instead
  • SuperMedo Server is open to everyone. Online co-op → Co-op pool → SuperMedo Server, press Sign up to make an account at supermedo.com, then enter your username and password. No Tailscale needed
  • You can still play on any shadNet server as before

If it crashes

Send the whole user\last_run.log file, along with your CPU, GPU, driver version and RAM, and when it happened.

releases.name: Bloodborne for Windows 1.7.5: cleaner Online page
releases.notes:
Cleaner Online co-op page.

Changed

  • Each co-op pool now shows only its own settings. SuperMedo Server shows just Sign up, your username and password, with its own account (separate from a shadNet account). Server addresses aren't shown

If it crashes

Send the whole user\last_run.log file, along with your CPU, GPU, driver version and RAM, and when it happened.

releases.name: Bloodborne for Windows 1.7.4: ultrawide, Quit to Desktop, SuperMedo Server
releases.notes:
Ultrawide screens, Quit to Desktop in the game's menus, and a new co-op server. Thanks to @emurphy04 for the ultrawide and Quit to Desktop work.

New

  • Ultrawide output (21:9 and 32:9): 2560x1080, 3440x1440, 3840x1600, 5120x2160, 3840x1080 and 5120x1440 in the launcher (Display) and the in-game menu. The camera and HUD are widened for your screen's shape. HUD position chooses whether health, items and Blood Echoes sit at the screen edges or stay in the centred 16:9 area. Changing to or from an ultrawide size needs a restart
  • Quit to Desktop in the game's own title menu and System menu. From the System menu the game saves first, then closes. You can turn it off on the Cheats page
  • SuperMedo Server, a third choice under Online co-op → Co-op pool, next to shadNet and The Hunter's Dream. Press Sign up for SuperMedo Server to make an account, put it in the Account boxes, and have Tailscale connected

Fixed

  • A crash when a video stopped or the game closed while a video was playing
  • Mods being rejected as file conflicts in some setups

If it crashes

Send the whole user\last_run.log file (not a screenshot of the last few lines), along with your CPU, GPU, driver version and RAM, and when it happened (at startup, loading an area, after playing a while).

releases.name: Bloodborne for Windows 1.7.3: crash, online and Xbox controller fixes
releases.notes:
Fixes for problems reported on Discord.

Fixed

  • Crash during play or at the cutscene after Rom, where the log shows four Patched SRT walker ... fault address 0x0 lines and then Fault: read access to 0000000000000000 at bb-probe.exe+0x1b5bf2. The game sometimes sends a draw with an empty pointer and the port crashed reading it. That draw is skipped now
  • PLAY failing with PermissionError: [WinError 32] (boot-libc.bin). An antivirus scanning the freshly built file was holding it. The launcher waits and tries again now instead of giving up
  • Online: "failed to get server information" with SSL server verification failed in the log. An extra Windows-only certificate check tripped over an old expired certificate on some PCs. It's gone, so you don't need to delete certificates in certmgr anymore. The normal certificate check is still there
  • Xbox and other XInput controllers can now use both touchpad halves. Back + d-pad left opens gestures, Back + d-pad right opens key items. Back on its own still opens gestures (when you let go of it)
  • Freeze at the cutscene after Rom with a modified eboot.bin. The launcher now tells you right away when your eboot.bin isn't the clean 1.09 one, instead of hiding it in the log. Replace it with the one from an unmodified 1.09 update

If it crashes

Send the whole user\last_run.log file (not a screenshot of the last few lines), along with your CPU, GPU, driver version and RAM, and when it happened (at startup, loading an area, after playing a while).

releases.name: Bloodborne for Windows 1.7.2: RX 6000 crash fix, mouse wheel
releases.notes:
Small update on top of 1.7.1.

Fixed

  • AMD RX 6000 cards (and older) crashing as soon as the world appears with an upscaler on (Device lost during submit). The fix in 1.7.1 wasn't enough for these cards. Object motion now turns itself off on AMD cards older than the RX 7000 series. FSR 3.1 and FSR 4 keep working, moving enemies are just a little less sharp. If you want to test it anyway, put BB_OBJECT_MOTION=1 in Advanced → Extra variables

New

  • Mouse wheel on the Controls page. Press Set… next to a button and scroll the wheel (up, down, or tilt it left/right) to bind it. Like the mouse buttons, it works while the mouse is captured (mouse look on)

If it crashes

Send the whole user\last_run.log file (not a screenshot of the last few lines), along with your CPU, GPU, driver version and RAM, and when it happened (at startup, loading an area, after playing a while).

releases.name: Bloodborne for Windows 1.7.1: controller, online and VRAM fixes, The Hunter's Dream co-op
releases.notes:
Fixes for the problems people hit after 1.7, plus a new way to play online.

Thanks to @Vorshim92, @andrecabralgit, @parsifal295 and @cassioKenji for the pull requests, and to @MaskZeus for bbbridge.

Fixed

  • Controller stopped working after updating to 1.7. If you opened the Controls page before starting the game once, the launcher saved an input.ini without any controller lines. That no longer happens, and a broken input.ini gets its controller and keyboard lines back by itself, so you don't need to delete anything
  • Online: nobody could connect. The public shadNet server now signs out any client that doesn't say which version it is (you'd see Login rejected error code 5 in the log). The game reports its version now and stays signed in
  • Crashes when video memory runs out (mostly 6 GB cards, where the log said something like memory pressure, 6333 of 2537 MiB). When the card is full the game now goes on using system memory, a bit slower for a moment, instead of crashing. Old textures from areas you've left are also freed when the card is really full
  • AMD RX 6000 cards crashing at the first frame with any upscaler on (Device lost during submit)
  • "GPU readbacks: Precise" hanging on a black screen at startup
  • A crash or force-quit while the game is saving can't damage your save anymore: the save is written to a copy first and swapped in at the end
  • Patches, mods and the weapon sound fix now recognise every region's version of the game
  • The in-game menu (Insert or L3+R3) stays on screen at lower resolutions

New

  • Play with bbhost players on The Hunter's Dream. In the launcher, go to Online co-op, choose The Hunter's Dream under Co-op pool and press Sign in with Discord. Enter the code the launcher shows on the page that opens and you're in. No shadNet account needed. This goes through bbbridge by MaskZeus, which the launcher starts and stops with the game, so you don't have to run anything else. There's also an option to show yourself on the live map at thehuntersdream.com/map
  • The old way (a shadNet account on srv.shadps4.net) still works, pick shadNet server for that
  • Quit game button in the in-game menu, so you can leave with a controller (press it twice)
  • The log now has a memory line every minute, which makes crash reports a lot more useful

If it crashes

Send the whole user\last_run.log file (not a screenshot of the last few lines), along with your CPU, GPU, driver version and RAM, and when it happened (at startup, loading an area, after playing a while).

Your Hunter's Dream account is stored in user\bbbridge\bbbridge_state.json. Don't share that file with anyone.

releases.name: Bloodborne for Windows 1.7: crash fixes, keyboard and mouse
releases.notes:
Big one. Mostly crash fixes, plus keyboard and mouse support.

A lot of this came from people sending pull requests, so huge thanks to @d4rksp4rt4n, @andrecabralgit, @noatdk, @DUDUYG, @parsifal295, @ayozetr, @Jgamrot, @dGstone18, @jpramosjp, @T0ug, @FIocker, @cassioKenji, @Jhony-Jhansen, @Berleis, @pyL1nx and @Aljoscha-Ide. The mouse camera is imedved's work, ported by @mcrib884.

Crashes fixed

  • Game crashing the moment you get hit on Intel 12th gen or newer CPUs
  • VRAM filling up as you move through areas until the game dies (mostly 6-8 GB cards). If your log kept saying "0 images evicted", this was it
  • Random crashes while playing (write access to 0x8 or read access to 0x20000)
  • Crash while loading an area (SrtWalkerSignalHandler: Assertion Failed)
  • AMD cards crashing on every start with Failed to create graphics pipeline: ErrorUnknown
  • Crash right after launch with some repacks and badly updated dumps. If your eboot.bin isn't the real 1.09 one, the game now runs at 30 FPS instead of crashing, and the log tells you why
  • "Close the launcher when the game starts" breaking the launch (Errno 22)
  • Game prep failing on Japanese, Chinese and Korean Windows

Other fixes

  • Older Intel CPUs (2nd and 3rd gen, like the i7-2600 or i7-3770) can run the game now. It's best effort, a few rarely used instructions aren't handled yet. CPUs without AVX (a lot of Pentiums and Celerons) still can't run it, but you get a message now instead of the game just closing
  • The character preview on the creation screen actually shows your character
  • Sprint no longer gets stuck at half speed after bumping into something at high FPS
  • The FPS patches set the physics step properly now (it was written to the wrong address)
  • Smoother frame pacing when you use a frame cap
  • Audio was way too quiet on stereo headphones and speakers
  • Summoning with the bells works on the default server
  • Mods work with Windows Developer Mode turned on
  • Checkboxes and sliders in the in-game menu actually stick now
  • A little lighter on the GPU (around 0.5 ms per frame)

New stuff

  • Keyboard and mouse: rebind keys on the new Controls page, mouse look, and an optional 1:1 mouse camera. Heads up, Q is lock-on now and V is Triangle. Everything's in docs/INPUT.md
  • The in-game menu (Insert or L3+R3) is in English now
  • Text and voice language can be set separately, Brazilian Portuguese text included
  • The Old Hunters works on base-game dumps, just point the launcher at your DLC folder
  • Optional Japanese button layout (Circle to confirm) on the Cheats page
  • Achievements page in the launcher

Requirements

You need an Intel Core 4th gen (Haswell) or newer, or any Ryzen. 2nd and 3rd gen Intel work with the fallback mentioned above.

If it crashes

Send the whole user\last_run.log file (not a screenshot of the last few lines), along with your CPU, GPU, driver version and RAM. Saying when it happened (at startup, loading an area, after playing a while) helps a lot.

Updating

Hit Update in the launcher. Your saves, settings, key bindings and mods stay as they are.

releases.name: Bloodborne for Windows 1.6: online play
releases.notes:
What's new in 1.6

Online play (beta)

  • Messages, bloodstains and wandering ghosts from other hunters, through The Hunter's Dream.
  • Sign-in, bells and summons through a shadNet server (shadPS4's public server by default).
  • New Online co-op page in the launcher, with a Test connection button.

How to go online:

  1. Register an account at https://shadnet.shadps4.net
  2. In the launcher, open Online co-op, tick Play online, and enter your account name (not your email) and password.
  3. Press PLAY and choose online at the title screen. The Hunter's Dream welcome message means you are online.

Summoning between players is new and not confirmed yet. Tell us on Discord how it goes.

Also new

  • Add to Steam: puts Bloodborne in your Steam library in one click (Play page).
  • Play online switch on the Play page, and the status line shows Online or Offline.
  • The launcher now always writes user\last_run.log: attach it when you report a problem.

Your saves, settings and mods are kept when you update.

Discord: https://discord.gg/yTMG8c4Bqm

releases.name: Bloodborne for Windows 1.5 (DLSS)
releases.notes:
New: NVIDIA DLSS

  • DLSS Super Resolution for GeForce RTX cards (RTX 20 series and newer, current driver). Pick it in the launcher (Graphics → Upscaler → DLSS) or in the in-game menu. On other GPUs it is greyed out; FSR 3.1 and FSR 4 are still there for everyone.
  • It uses the same game data the FSR upscalers get (depth, motion vectors, jitter), and the quality mode follows your preset (Quality, Balanced, Performance…).

Frame generation (DLSS and FSR) is being worked on for a later version.

If you have 1.2 or newer, the launcher offers this update by itself (Update, bottom left).

No game files are included. You need your own dump of Bloodborne CUSA03173; version 1.09 for the community patches.

DLSS support is adapted from IFreemz/shadPS4-Bloodborne-DLSS-FSR. NVIDIA, GeForce RTX and DLSS are trademarks of NVIDIA Corporation; nvngx_dlss.dll is included under NVIDIA's license (see licenses\).

releases.name: Bloodborne for Windows 1.4
releases.notes:
Fixed

  • Character creation looked frozen. Choosing "Enter Name" opened the name entry only in the window's title bar, so in fullscreen or with a controller nothing seemed to happen. The name entry is now a box in the middle of the screen. It starts with your player name from the launcher (or "Hunter"):
    • Keyboard: type, Backspace to erase, Enter to accept, Esc to cancel.
    • Controller: Cross (A) to accept, Circle (B) to cancel.
  • AMD cards: two more AMD-only crashes are fixed: with sharpness set above 1.0, and when changing the FSR 4 preset or output resolution in the game.

Known issue

  • The character preview on the right of the creation screen stays empty. Your character is created correctly and looks right in the game.

If you have 1.2 or 1.3, the launcher offers this update by itself (Update, bottom left).

No game files are included. You need your own dump of Bloodborne CUSA03173; version 1.09 for the community patches.

Windows build of bbport, the native Bloodborne port by deadinside28.
